_comment: Which Supabase project is which. Committed on purpose: a project ref is not
a secret (it is in the URL of every API call the app makes), but knowing
which ref is production IS load-bearing, and until now that knowledge lived
only in GitHub Actions secrets where nothing local could reach it.
friday refuses to talk to any database until both refs below are filled in.
A local tool that cannot tell staging from production is more dangerous
Find each ref at: https://supabase.com/dashboard  ->  project  ->

production._hint: A ref appears in the repo already: supabase/migrations/20260823090000_notification_crons.sql points its cron jobs at zcvwamziybpslpavjljw.supabase.co, and scripts/apply-migration.ts names the same project. That is almost certainly production, but friday will not assume it. Confirm in the dashboard before filling this in.
